description: The generic webhook shape accepted on POST /webhook/generic. Required set is grounded in _normalize_generic: only 'service' is required (missing ⇒ Unparseable); everything else degrades to defaults (severity→'info', title→'<service>:<check>', metric fields→null). ADR-005 HMAC is mandatory on this route (fail-closed). additionalProperties:true — the Tolerant Reader rule: unknown fields are ignored, never fatal.

alert_id.description: Caller-supplied alert identity. Absent ⇒ L2 falls back to the fingerprint.

labels.description: Free-form string labels → Alert.labels. env/cluster/region SHOULD be present — they are fingerprint-identity inputs (ADR-017 v2).

metric.description: Optional numeric observation. Non-numeric or malformed metric objects degrade to nulls at L2, never to Unparseable.

breach_duration_s.description: How long the breach has held, seconds.

value.description: The observed metric value, if any.

service.description: The emitting service → Alert.service. The single required field; missing ⇒ Unparseable.

severity.description: Source severity label → Alert.severity_in, passed through un-normalized (default 'info').

title: Generic webhook — ingress shape (contract C1)
